question: can the sticker catalogue be filled from what is already on disk?
why_zero: the six skipped drafts are the ones the editor created - they are encrypted, so the scanner cannot read a timeline from them
the five readable drafts are CLI-built and contain only text and video materials, so there is no sticker or effect id to learn
consequence: sticker ids cannot be harvested from this machine's state. The supported path is `jianying media harvest-enums add <KIND> <SLUG> <RESOURCE_ID>` - register one manually witnessed id once, then reference it by id.
also_learned: the same encryption that breaks draft_resource receipts also breaks enum harvesting, so any feature that reads the editor's drafts inherits that limitation
not_proven: that a sticker placed by hand in the editor would be harvestable - it would be encrypted too
that the add path produces a catalogue usable by the generator; it was not exercised end to end here
